testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch backward and forward between neighboring part tabs ✔ Given two part tabs are adjacent in the MCAD Software ✔ And the part on the right is active ✔ When the user presses Control+Shift+Tab ✔ Then the part on the left becomes active ✔ And its viewport and model browser are displayed ✔ When the user presses Control+Tab ✔ Then the part on the right becomes active again ✔ And its viewport and model browser are displayed
